purpose: Test whether an organism-specific learned self-dynamics model causally improves held-out control, including an intervention that damages the self-model.

policies.self_model: learn organism-specific gain g_hat and bias from training action/state transitions; choose action maximizing predicted next-state reward
policies.reactive: fixed threshold controller based only on current e: +1 if e<4.5, -1 if e>5.5, else 0
policies.damaged_self_model: same learned policy but replace g_hat with registered generic gain 1.0 at evaluation
policies.oracle: true g and true transition model; positive control

metrics.primary: self_model mean held-out reward minus reactive reward

interpretation_rule: PASS establishes only that an organism-specific model of its own action-state dynamics causally improves held-out control in this synthetic task. It does not establish consciousness, subjective self-awareness, general self-knowledge, intelligence, or universality.
